text:
ashok: Quick heads-up — Q3 eval job ramp will start next Tue. Need to discuss reserving steady headroom for eval queues (long seq jobs) separate from interactive burst. Current autoscaler treats them same and we're seeing eviction spikes.

sara: Do we have numbers? how many GPU hours expected?

ashok: Rough calc: 1200 GPU-hours over 48h during peak (mostly p4d). That's ~25% of our eu-west pool if we don't reserve.

james: +1 to separate. Eval jobs have high mem, low arrivals — we can put them behind a capacity class that uses dedicated slots not burst. 

maria: Proposal: create `capacity.class=eval` with min_replicas=6 and max_replicas=12, excluded from spot_slice. That keeps latency and reduces preemptions. Thoughts?

zoe: Sounds good. What's the impact to customers during promos? we can't starve interactive traffic.

ashok: We'll add a soft-failover: if interactive queue > 80% SLO, eval capacity gets throttled and queued. Implement with a policy tweak below:

```
policy:
  name: eval_isolation_v1
  target_pool: eu-west
  reserved_slots: 6
  burst_allowed: false
  preemptible_mix: 0.0
  throttle_condition: "interactive_p95 > 120ms"
```

sara: can autoscale-bot simulate this before rollout?

autoscale-bot: Simulation started for policy `eval_isolation_v1` on pool eu-west. ETA 12m. Results will be posted here.

autoscale-bot: Simulation complete — peak latency for interactive unchanged, eval completion time +40% under heavy load, preemptions 0. Recommended.

james: Nice. Ops ask: add an alert if reserved capacity drops below min (node failures). Want to create runbook for manual spillover.

maria: Agreed. I'll add a Prom alert: `reserved_eval_slots_below_min{pool=\"eu-west\"} > 0` and a runbook link.

ashok: I'll schedule canary on Tue 06:00 UTC. If anyone sees weird throttling, ping me @ashok immediately. :pray:

zoe: Thanks — will update capacity forecast and cost delta (+~6% infra for the week).

maria: PR incoming for config + runbook. tagging: @sara @james for review.

sara: lgtm, will review PR today.

ashok: awesome — closing thread once PR merged.
